name: 4-fluoroisobutyrfentanyl
summary: 4-Fluoroisobutyrylfentanyl (also known as 4-FIBF and p-FIBF) is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of butyrfentanyl and structural isomer of 4-Fluorobutyrfentanyl and has been sold online as a designer drug.2 nM for the human μ-opioid receptor. 4-fluoroisobutyrylfentanyl is a highly selective μ-opioid receptor agonist whose analgesic potency is almost ten times of that reported for morphine.

pharmacology.text: It is closely related to 4-fluorofentanyl, which has an EC50 value of 4.2 nM for the human μ-opioid receptor. 4-fluoroisobutyrylfentanyl is a highly selective μ-opioid receptor agonist whose analgesic potency is almost ten times of that reported for morphine.

uses.text: 4-Fluoroisobutyrylfentanyl (also known as 4-FIBF and p-FIBF) is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of butyrfentanyl and structural isomer of 4-Fluorobutyrfentanyl and has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of fentanyl analogs are similar to those of fentanyl itself, which include itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression, which can be life-threatening. Fentanyl analogs have killed hundreds of people throughout Europe and the former Soviet republics since the most recent resurgence in use began in Estonia in the early 2000s, and novel derivatives continue to appear.

fact.en: It and 4-fluorobutyrfentanyl share exactly the same atoms, C23H29FN2O, and differ only in whether a four-carbon chain is straight or branched. Its parent family began with fentanyl, first made by Paul Janssen in 1960.
fact.zh: 它與4-氟丁醯吩坦尼的原子組成完全相同（C23H29FN2O），差別只在一條四碳鏈是直的還是有分支。它所屬的家族源自吩坦尼，由Paul Janssen於1960年首次合成。
fact.zhHans: 它与4-氟丁酰吩坦尼的原子组成完全相同（C23H29FN2O），差别只在一条四碳链是直的还是有分支。它所属的家族源自吩坦尼，由Paul Janssen于1960年首次合成。
